newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Central Europe's CESI index eases.
newsitem.headline: Central Europe's CESI index eases.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index dropped on Thursday to close at 1,513.64 points, down 3.03 points or 0.20 percent, the Budapest Stock Stock Exchange said.
The fall of the index was triggered primarily by losses on the Polish market.
The index, which has been published since February 1, reflects trends of 50 shares on the Budapest, Prague and Warsaw bourses. -- Budapest newsroom (36 1) 266 2410
